name: Poisoner’s Kit
description:
Vials and preparation implements support work with poisons. Appropriate proficiency applies to relevant preparation and handling checks.

Uses the 2014 rules; the GM resolves applicability. Legality depends on the campaign.

name: Basic Poison
description:
One vial coats one slashing or piercing weapon, or up to three pieces of ammunition, using an action. A hit requires a DC 10 Constitution save; failure adds 1d4 poison damage. The coating loses potency after one minute. Coating, saves and damage are resolved manually; using this Item consumes the vial only.

Uses the 2014 rules; the GM resolves applicability. Legality depends on the campaign.
